subject: Token billing roadmap & pricing scenarios for Helix PoC
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery + token volumes (Helix PoC)

Thanks again for taking the call earlier, Olivia — quick recap and next steps from our side.

Key takeaways from the discovery call: 
- PoC scope: API-based routing for clinical triage assistant, ~4–6 endpoints (chat+summaries).
- Current expected traffic: ~200k tokens/day during initial pilot (2–4 weeks), trending to ~1.5–2M tokens/day in month 3–6 if early success metrics hit.
- Latency SLO: 300–500ms p50 for short-turn interactions; some async batch summarization acceptable at higher latency.
- Security: Helix requires SOC 2 + audit logs; we have Private options if needed.

Pricing/finance items you asked about: 
- Target unit: you mentioned a target $/1M tokens benchmark for budgeting.
- We wanted to capture a budget range and confirm whether you prefer committed reserved capacity (discounted, monthly commit) vs. on-demand usage.

Attachments: I attached a small workbook (Helix_token_volume_workbook.xlsx) with the volumes we discussed — please review the volumes tab and flag anything off.

Action items for Helix: 
1) Confirm the 200k -> 1.5–2M tokens/day trajectory (or share corrected estimates per endpoint).
2) Confirm target $/1M tokens range for pilot vs. steady-state.
3) Confirm procurement timelines and any mandatory security docs.

Action items for Redwood (mine):
- Produce a simple invoice estimate and three pricing scenarios (pilot, growth, scale) with line items for model unit costs, caching benefits, and reserved capacity options. Marissa will draft the invoice file.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Marissa (pricing) and Sean (solutions) to get a draft over by Monday.

—
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@helixhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + token volumes (Helix PoC)

Thanks Mina — quick clarifications below.

Confirmed: pilot ~200k tokens/day (conservative), expecting 1.5M/day by month 4 if clinical QA is green. Potential longer-term peak ~5M/day at 12 months if rollout to additional sites.

Budget guidance: for internal planning we are aiming for a target band of $1,000–$1,200 per 1M tokens for the pilot (committed), with room to negotiate at scale. This is our finance team's internal anchor — we understand higher performance/latency tiers cost more.

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you show line-items that separate model compute, KV/prefix cache savings, and reserved capacity amortization?
- Any quick notes on expected cache hit assumptions (we saw numbers of 20–60% on other vendors) and how that impacts effective $/1M?
- SOC 2 + evidence: please point us to the attestation and expected delivery timeline.

I’ll loop procurement (Arjun) for PO timing — we’re trying to get a PO in place by Sep 10 if pricing lands in our band.

Olivia
Head of Automation | Helix Health
olivia@helixhealth.com

Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Draft invoice + pricing scenarios (Helix PoC)

Hi Olivia / Mina — attaching a short PDF with three scenario summaries (redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf) and a draft invoice spreadsheet (draft-invoice-Helix-2026-08.xlsx). High-level assumptions baked into the numbers below; please review and tell us which scenario aligns best.

Assumptions (applies across scenarios):
- Model: redwood-l2-medium (quantized runtime)
- Baseline autoscale: 2 inference nodes for pilot, warm KV cache on prefix hits
- Cache hit assumed at 40% for the pilot, 55% at growth, 65% at scale (customer-provided content patterns assumed).
- Routing: latency-priority routing for chat endpoints; cheaper routing for batch summarization.
- Inbound data egress ignored (no special transfer fees).

Scenario A — Pilot (200k tokens/day)
- Effective unit: $1,150 per 1M tokens
- Monthly estimate: ~$7,000 (assuming 30-day month)

Scenario B — Growth (1.5M tokens/day)
- Effective unit: $880 per 1M tokens (reflects reserved discount + higher cache hit)
- Monthly estimate: ~$40,000

Scenario C — Scale (5M tokens/day)
- Effective unit: $620 per 1M tokens (committed capacity + further ops efficiencies)
- Monthly estimate: ~$93,000

Line items included in draft invoice: model compute, memory-backed KV cache premium, reserved capacity amortization (if commit), support (SLA) fee, and one-time onboarding credit. We included a toggle in the workbook to show effect of changing cache hit % and committed hours.

Next steps: 
- Olivia: pick the scenario that best matches your plan or tell us a custom volume.
- Mina/Marissa: if Growth scenario is closest, we can convert the draft into a formal SOW/quote and include the SOC 2 evidence link.

Attachments: draft-invoice-Helix-2026-08.xlsx (pricing workbook), redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf (one-pager).

—
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We reviewed the scenarios and Growth (Scenario B) aligns best with our expected rollout. A few final items before we proceed to PO: 
- Can you add an explicit line in the invoice that shows the delta at 45% vs 55% cache hit so finance can see sensitivity?
- Please include a short note on how we would convert reserved hours into a monthly invoice (commit vs true-up cadence).
- Send SOC 2 attestation link and the most recent penetration test report.

Procurement timeline: Arjun will manage PO and expects to have an initial draft ready by Sep 3 and a formal PO by Sep 10, pending legal review.

Arjun (cc): please confirm if you need any additional docs from Redwood to start the internal PO packet.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
